description: This file defines a static class 'SubscriptionMarker' used to mark and check subscription IDs as either explicit or implicit within the Orleans streaming framework. It uses bitwise operations on GUIDs to encode the subscription type in the high bit of the last byte of the GUID.

classes.name: SubscriptionMarker
classes.description: A static utility class for marking GUIDs as explicit or implicit subscription IDs based on a bit flag.

methods.name: MarkAsExplicitSubscriptionId
methods.description: Marks a GUID as an explicit subscription ID by setting the high bit.

methods.name: MarkAsImplictSubscriptionId
methods.description: Marks a GUID as an implicit subscription ID by setting the high bit.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscription
methods.description: Checks if a GUID is marked as an implicit subscription by inspecting the high bit of the last byte.

methods.name: MarkSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Internal helper method that sets or clears the high bit of a GUID based on the subscription type.
